main.description: A node's description of itself, stored in its owner's repo. Doubles as the request to join. Signed by the node's own signing key. Public: anyone can read it.

network.description: The network this node belongs to.

name.description: Optional device name. Reveals what devices the owner has.

homeRelays.description: Relays this node listens on for signals.

relay.description: Set only if this node acts as a relay. Its approval must also allow it.

updatedAt.description: Increases with every change. Nodes ignore versions older than one they have seen.

endpoint.description: HTTPS base URL serving this relay's is.neuros.descale.relay.* methods. Public: publishing it reveals the relay's address.

tlsKeyPin.description: SHA-256 of the DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the relay's TLS key, for relays with self-signed certificates. When set, clients accept only a certificate with this key and skip CA and hostname checks. Covers HTTPS and TURN over TLS.
